_comment: Prod S3 bucket CORS (dev MinIO allows * globally). Apply: aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket <bucket> --cors-configuration file://infra/s3-cors.json. Replace the origin with the public app host(s). POST/DELETE are required by browser multipart uploads (Create/Complete/AbortMultipartUpload); ETag must be exposed so the client can complete the upload.
